scientific_integrity: The conclusions use explicit analytic spectral and convexity arguments; finite numerical matrices are corroboration, not proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the invariant optimizer set is classified; no uniqueness among all asymmetric optimizers is asserted.
The theorem requires n >= 5, B>0, and strictly positive rim price.
It concerns continuous-time eigenvalue optimization, not discrete-time SLEM.
Equivalent unindexed treatments cannot be excluded.
title: A sharp rim-price deletion transition for fastest diffusion on helm networks
